verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a low-friction prototype start: anonymous CLI deploys and drag-and-drop folders. It also shows a consistent set of platform primitives (serverless functions, blob storage, managed Postgres, REST API/CLI), and the docs claim security 'at any scale,' from a personal portfolio to a banking site. However, nothing documents that these same APIs carry an app to massive scale without rearchitecting. The only 'scale to millions' claim comes from a third-party Clerk template. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of scaling limits and continuity for functions, storage and database, case studies or independent reports of apps growing to large scale on the same primitives, and hands-on corroboration that no migration was needed.
